messages:
arjun: Heads-up — we're planning a credential rotation for the Splunk shipper tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Also planning to tighten raw-export retention TTL from 90d -> 30d. Need to confirm: will rotating shipper creds / rewrapping KMS-wrapped archives break anything? Anyone from security/infra have a quick checklist? @mina @ellie

mina: Short answer: rotation of the shipper service account key is low risk if it's just a push credential. The risk is when envelope keys (CMKs) are rotated or if the shipper performs on-the-fly rewraps. If archives are already KMS-wrapped with a customer CMK, we must re-wrap them to a new CMK or update key policy. Share the shipper config?

arjun: Config snippet (staging):
```
shipper: 
  target: splunk-ingest.prod.redwood
  auth: vault:secret/data/shipper/splunk-token
  envelope_key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
  rotate_interval: 90d
  archive_ttl: 90d
```

ellie: Quick notes:
- The shipper uses a vault-stored token tied to a service account. Rotating that token = update vault + restart shipper sidecar.
- If you rotate the CMK (envelope_key) you need a rewrap job to avoid losing access to archived blobs.
Plan I suggest: 1) create new service account + new secret in vault, 2) update staging shipper to use new secret and smoke-test, 3) run rewrap dry-run against a small archive set (staging), 4) schedule prod rotation and rewrap window.
Also: retention change (90d -> 30d) has downstream implications for forensic and vuln triage. @sec-oncall can we get a sign-off pattern? :thinking_face:

sec-oncall: We can't drop to 30d universally without exceptions. Forensics and legal-hold cases need >=60-90d. Propose: default archive_ttl=30d, but support tag-based exceptions (e.g., `forensics:true`, `legal-hold:true`) that preserve 90d+ or infinite. We'll need a small exception approval flow.

samir: On RBAC: who can request the 90d exception? Right now 'analyst' role doesn't have that permission. I recommend a JIT elevation via our OPA plugin + an approval ticket in Zendesk/hr-triage. Template fields: dataset, justification, evidence id, expiry. Also: KMS-proxy token TTL is currently 6h; rewrap jobs run >6h in some cases and fail. Recommend 24h ephemeral tokens for rewrap service principal, scoped only to Rewrap and ListKey operations. Audit trail required.

mina: Agree with scoped 24h tokens for the rewrap-runbooks. Minimal scope + allowlist for the rewrap principal. Add CloudTrail filter/alert for KeyUsage and GenerateDataKey/Decrypt events for any CMK used in exports. Also add an automated smoke check that tries `Decrypt` on a test blob post-rotation.

arjun: Action items I hear: 1) @ellie run shipper rotation dry-run in staging (dry-run should include a rewrap test on a tiny dataset). 2) @mina draft KMS-proxy scope + 24h token request flow + CloudTrail alerts. 3) @samir design RBAC/JIT flow + ticket template. 4) @sec-oncall confirm exception policy and provide templated approval. I will hold prod rotation until we have sign-offs.

ops-bot: scheduled dry-run created by ellie: run_id=run-2026-03-24-01, window=2026-03-24T06:00:00Z (staging). Link: https://deploys.redwood/run/run-2026-03-24-01 :white_check_mark:

ellie: On it — I'll coordinate with data-privacy and list datasets that need 90d retention. I'll post the list here before the dry-run.

sec-oncall: I approve the default 30d with the tag-based exception model + legal-hold passthrough. I'll add the formal exception template to the compliance repo and ping once done. :+1:
